meta.source: data/Wardogs/Content (CL516586 cooked export) plus package bytes for achievement parameter values

achievements.name: Punch Kristopher
achievements.criteria: A character-damaged event whose target is Kristopher (the tutorial NPC) and whose damage is melee.

achievements.name: Top Cash Earner
achievements.criteria: No event trigger. Checked on a match stat: the player's cash-earned placement equals 1 and the cash earned is above 0.

achievements.name: Single Life Profit
achievements.criteria: Event.StateTree.ProfitChanged; a match-stat difference (profit) compared with CashThreshold using GreaterOrEqual.

achievements.name: Loadout Spender
achievements.criteria: Event.StateTree.LoadoutPurchased; the resource tag must equal cash and the resource change is compared with CashThreshold using GreaterOrEqual.

achievements.name: Control Zone Survivor
achievements.criteria: Entering a control zone starts a timer; the achievement unlocks when RequiredSeconds pass in the zone and the pawn is still alive. Death resets the watch.

achievements.name: Long Shot
achievements.criteria: Event.StateTree.LongShotVitalityChanged; the target is hostile and the message Distance (float) is compared with DistanceThreshold using GreaterOrEqual.

achievements.name: Clean Sweep
achievements.criteria: No event trigger. Checked on the final faction scores: the player's own faction score is above 0 and the opposing faction's score is 0.

achievements.name: Ricochet Kill
achievements.criteria: Event.StateTree.RicochetVitalityChanged; the target is hostile and the kill carries the ricochet tag.

achievements.name: Defibrillator Kill
achievements.criteria: Event.StateTree.DefibrillatorVitalityChanged; the target is hostile and the kill carries the defibrillator tag.

actions.name: Get {Count} Kills
rules: You must be inside the control zone
Not a player an enemy revived
Repeats on the same player don't count

actions.name: Deliver {Count} people to the Control Zone
actions.description: Get this amount of players delivered to the Control Zone
rules: Counts once your passenger survives the drop-off

actions.name: Revive {Count} Teammates
rules: You must be inside the control zone
Not a player downed by a teammate or by themselves
Repeats on the same player don't count

actions.name: Destroy {Count} Occupied Vehicles
actions.description: Destroy this many vehicles that have an enemy occupant.
rules: An enemy must be driving it
An enemy must have bought it
